name: Williamson County, TN
findings: Williamson County has 1,187 nonprofit organizations. 456 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 373 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Williamson County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
